items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: They used to call him -- Joe used to give him the devil and call him Sweetie.

ctx.x: How much were you making then?
$25 a week. So I was making '35 a week, then, see? And that was big money in those days, you know. But our tips -- we had a kitty, and we was doing all right.
But Albert did dirty, you see. He was sneaky. He wouldn't tell the man, he said, "Well, I'm going to Chicago. Don't fire him." I don't know, he didn't tell the man that.
